a) All the vaccines which are under Universal Immunization Programme of
India (UIP) will be deemed included in NLEM. Presently, the UIP has BCG,
DPT, OPV, measles, Hepatitis B, Japanese encephalitis & Pentavalent Vaccines.
b) The new vaccines, which have been approved by National Technical
Advisory Group on Immunization (NTAGI)and planned to be given under UIP,
will be deemed to be included as and when listed in UIP. These vaccines are
inactivated polio vaccine (IPV), Measles Rubella (MR) and Rota virus vaccine.
